channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Changesets v3: Bumps Peer Dependents by Patch and Ships ESM Only with an 88% Smaller Install
item.description: Changesets v3.0, released on August 11, 2026, introduces significant updates for JavaScript monorepos. It offers leaner installations, a rebuilt CLI, and changes to peer dependency management that resolve long-standing complaints. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon ECS now provides real-time deployment observability in the AWS Management Console
item.description: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now provides real-time service deployment observability in the Amazon ECS Console for native Linear, Canary, and Blue/Green deployment strategies. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EVS now in scope for FedRAMP Class C
item.description: The Amazon Elastic VMware Service (EVS) service is now in scope for FedRAMP Class C (formerly Moderate baseline) in all United States Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Java News Roundup: JDK 27, Open J Proxy, A2A Jakarta, Azul Payara, BoxLang, Netflix ja
item.description: This week's Java roundup for September 14th, 2026, features news highlighting: the GA release of JDK 27, LibericaJDK 27, Open J Proxy 1.0 and A2A Jakarta 1.0; point releases of Azul Payara, JHipster, JetBrains Ktor and BoxLang; and… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon EC2 I7ie instances now available in AWS Israel region
item.description: AWS is announcing starting today, Amazon EC2 I7ie instances are now available in AWS Israel (Tel Aviv) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Talent is now generally available
item.description: Amazon Connect Talent is now generally available, giving talent acquisition leaders an AI-powered hiring solution that accelerates candidate selection at scale. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS STS simplifies session token size limits and adds session token size monitoring
item.description: AWS Security Token Service (STS) now enforces a single 4,096-byte size limit on session tokens. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Step Functions adds new AWS service integrations automatically, starting with AWS Lambda MicroVMs
item.description: AWS Step Functions now automatically adds AWS SDK integrations for new AWS services and capabilities within weeks of their release, starting with AWS Lambda MicroVMs, AWS Lambda Core and others. (1 source: aws)
